criteria.reasoning: Issue 1 flags "Draft requests $83,847" against the rule that "requests above $75,000 will not be considered." It dismisses the info-session remark: "A verbal flexibility comment does not override the written 'will not be considered' rule."
It states "line items sum to $71,910, not the $72,910 shown as total direct costs: $48,000 + $10,560 + $5,400 + $3,850 + $2,600 + $1,500 = $71,910," a $1,000 overstatement.
It flags indirect "at 15% of total direct costs" against the RFP cap of "10% of total direct costs" and says "The federal rate is irrelevant to this cap."

The corrected-figures table gives "≤$7,191 on corrected $71,910," and the fix says to "Correct direct-cost total, then cap indirect at ≤10% of that corrected total." The $7,291 figure appears only as the value on the misstated total, which the memo says must be resolved first; $7,191 is the maximum it uses ("$79,101 ($71,910 + $7,191)").

The memo sets the ceiling at "≤$75,000," and at "≤$68,000" if no new match is secured. It notes that $79,101 is "still $4,101 over $75,000 ... so direct cuts also required," and it never presents an amount above $75,000 as acceptable.

It states "Countable at deadline is therefore $34,000: $20,000 Council ... plus $14,000 board-designated reserve." It excludes the $12,000 Rio Grande in-kind and the undocumented $5,000 Rotary pledge, noting that "its vote is October 14, after the October 1 deadline."

It applies the "≥50% of request" rule: "$37,500 required; shortfall vs $34,000 = $3,500 new signed cash needed by deadline" and "Max request supportable by $34,000 | $68,000." It gives both fixes: secure more signed cash or cut the request to ≤$68,000.

Issue 4 says the "Required Sustainability Plan section is missing" and the Medicaid sentence "is not a Section 5 under the required heading." The fix is to "Add §5. Sustainability Plan under that exact heading."
It totals "§1 410 + §2 585 + §3 1,140 + §4 520 = 2,655 words ... That exceeds 2,500 by 155 words." It rejects the cover note's 2,135 and keeps the 480-word budget narrative outside the limit.

It states "4:30 p.m. MST therefore equals 5:30 p.m. MDT — 30 minutes after the portal closes" and "The compliant Phoenix equivalent of the deadline is 4:00 p.m. MST." The fix is to "Reassign upload to staff in New Mexico" and submit earlier.

The eligibility section concludes the operating-budget test is "Compliant" and that the "Prior-year audit does not disqualify." It says the Albuquerque headquarters "Appears compliant" because the RFP permits headquarters outside the counties, so neither the headquarters nor the audit is flagged as a violation.

The memo states the six line inputs "are as stated in draft" and says "do not change unit bases without new documentation." It locates the error only in the stated total and calls no line amount miscalculated.
